svg.title: Ra-Thor emblem concepts R1–R3 (RATHOR-EMBLEM-1)
svg.desc: Concept sheet. Hand-authored vector geometry. House recipe: polished gold, royal purple outline darker than every fill, ruby once per mark, one emboss. Silhouette fixed; colour and shading may be refined per theme. Not a production icon. info@Rathor.ai
